rules.title: Main loop required
rules.description: A track needs a closed main loop.

effect.message: Draw the main loop first.

rules.title: Alternative routes need a main loop

effect.message: Alternative routes must branch off a main loop; draw the main loop first.

rules.title: Alternative route ids are unique

effect.message: Alternative route id {$route.id} is used more than once.

rules.title: Crossing ids are unique

effect.message: Crossing id {$crossing.id} is used more than once.

rules.title: Jump ids are unique

effect.message: Jump id {$jump.id} is used more than once.

rules.title: Alternative routes must attach to the main loop
rules.description: Each alternative route needs a start and an end attachment on the main loop.

effect.message: Alternative route {$route.id} must start and end on the main loop.

rules.title: Alternative routes join the main loop
rules.description: The drawn ends must be close enough to the main loop to be snapped onto shared coordinates.

effect.message: Alternative route {$route.id} doesn't reach the main loop (gaps {$f.startGapM} m and {$f.endGapM} m; max {constants.attachmentToleranceM} m).

rules.title: Jumps are on a known route

effect.message: Jump {$jump.id} is on route {$jump.route}, which doesn't exist.

rules.title: Bridges go over a known route

effect.message: Crossing {$crossing.id} goes over route {$crossing.over.route}, which doesn't exist.

rules.title: Bridges say which branch goes over

effect.message: Bridge {$crossing.id} needs the branch that goes over.

rules.title: Grid fits two abreast
rules.description: The grid is laid out in pairs, so the track must be wide enough for two slots side by side.

effect.message: The grid needs at least {$needM} m of width for two cars abreast; the track is {options.widthM} m.

rules.title: First sector holds the grid
rules.description: The grid sits ahead of the start/finish line, so the clear road there (the first sector) must be at least ceil(gridSize / 2) x gridRowSpacingM long.

effect.message: A grid of {options.gridSize} needs a first sector of at least {$needM} m; it is {facts.firstSectorLengthM} m.

rules.title: Reverse layout keeps only bidirectional jumps
rules.description: One-directional jumps can't be driven backwards, so they are left out of the reverse layout.

effect.message: Jump {$jump.id} is one-directional and will be left out of the reverse layout; make it bidirectional to keep it.

rules.title: Reverse layout needs symmetric bridge ramps
rules.description: In a reverse layout, bridge ramps are driven both ways, so both ends get full-length ramps.

effect.message: Bridges get full-length ramps at both ends for the reverse layout.

rules.title: Crossings are marked
rules.description: Every place where the track crosses itself must be marked as a bridge or a flat crossing.

effect.message: The track crosses itself at ({$c.x}, {$c.y}); mark it as a bridge or a flat crossing.

rules.title: Crossing markers are on a crossing
rules.description: A crossing marker that isn't on a place where the track crosses itself is ignored by the build.

effect.message: Crossing {$crossing.id} isn't on a place where the track crosses itself, so it is ignored.

rules.title: No jumps near flat crossings
rules.description: A flat crossing is not allowed where either branch has a jump or ramp within flatCrossingJumpClearanceM. A crossing whose facts have no nearestJumpM has no jump or ramp on either branch.

effect.message: Flat crossing {$crossing.id} is {$f.nearestJumpM} m from a jump; keep jumps at least {constants.flatCrossingJumpClearanceM} m away or make it a bridge.

rules.title: Bridges have room for their ramps
rules.description: The over branch needs bridgeRampMinLengthM each side to climb to clearance height and back down.

effect.message: Bridge {$crossing.id} has only {$f.availableRampLengthM} m for its ramps; it needs {constants.bridgeRampMinLengthM} m.

rules.title: Layout fits the map
rules.description: All geometry must stay within +/-2000 m of the origin; beyond that car physics goes wrong.

effect.message: The scaled layout reaches {facts.maxAbsCoordinateM} m from the centre (max {constants.maxAbsCoordinateM} m); shorten the lap or make the sketch less elongated.

rules.title: Corners not too tight for the width
rules.description: The tightest centreline radius must be at least half the width plus minInnerEdgeRadiusM.

effect.message: The tightest corner has a {facts.minCornerRadiusM} m radius; a {options.widthM} m wide track needs at least {$needM} m.

rules.title: No pure tarmac in the sandpit
rules.description: The sandpit preset has no tarmac surroundings; use mixed for tarmac sections.

effect.reason: Tarmac isn't offered in the sandpit; choose mixed for tarmac sections.

rules.title: Sand only in sandy presets
rules.description: Provisional: sand surfaces are only offered in the sandpit and gravel pit presets.

effect.reason: Sand surfaces are only offered in the sandpit and gravel pit presets.

rules.title: No kerbs on sand
rules.description: Kerbs aren't placed on sand tracks, so the option is hidden.
